gloss: to fail to write; to make a mistake in writing

definitions.gloss: to fail to write; to miss writing; to make a mistake in writing
definitions.explanation: To either miss the opportunity to write something down, or to make an error while writing. A compound verb combining {書|か}く (to write) with the auxiliary {損|そこ}ねる (to fail to do, to miss doing).

examples.japanese: {名前|なまえ}を{書|か}き{損|そこ}ねた。
examples.english: I made a mistake writing the name.

examples.japanese: {住所|じゅうしょ}を{書|か}き{損|そこ}ねて、{最初|さいしょ}から{書|か}き{直|なお}した。
examples.english: I made an error writing the address and rewrote it from the beginning.

examples.japanese: {電話番号|でんわばんごう}を{書|か}き{損|そこ}ねて、{連絡|れんらく}が{取|と}れなくなってしまった。
examples.english: I wrote the phone number down wrong and couldn't get in touch.

notes:
A compound verb: {書|か}く (to write) + {損|そこ}ねる (to fail to do, to botch). The auxiliary verb 〜{損|そこ}ねる attaches to the stem of another verb to express failure or a missed opportunity. It follows the ichidan conjugation pattern.

RELATED COMPOUND VERBS WITH 〜{損|そこ}ねる:
- {言|い}い{損|そこ}ねる: to fail to say, to misspeak
- {読|よ}み{損|そこ}ねる: to misread, to fail to read
- {食|た}べ{損|そこ}ねる: to miss out on eating
- {乗|の}り{損|そこ}ねる: to miss (a train, bus)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {書|か}き{間違|まちが}える: to write incorrectly — focuses on the error itself rather than the failure
- {書|か}き{直|なお}す: to rewrite — the action taken after making a writing mistake
- {書|か}き{落|お}とす: to omit in writing — to accidentally leave something out
